description: Crown Lifters Limited engages in the hiring of cranes in India. Its fleet includes lattice boom cranes; telescopic boom cranes, and aerial work platforms in India. The company serves various sectors, such as oil and gas, refineries, steel, cement, fabrication, renewal, solar, thermal, nuclear energy, water/gas pipeline, breakwater, pile drive/caging, and dredging, as well as bridges, metros, bullet trains, and coastal roads. Crown Lifters Limited was founded in 1984 and is based in Mumbai, India.
